```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
if (ncol(movies) > 0) {
  missing_by_column <- movies |>
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing_values")
} else {
  missing_by_column <- tibble(column = character(), missing_values = integer())
}

missing_by_column
```

```{r}
if (ncol(movies) > 0 && all(c("title", "boxOffice") %in% names(movies))) {
  first_10_box_office <- movies |>
    filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
    select(title, boxOffice) |>
    slice_head(n = 10)
} else {
  first_10_box_office <- tibble(title = character(), boxOffice = numeric())
}

first_10_box_office
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ", ")

movies_clean
```

```{r}
genre_counts <- movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)

genre_counts
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audience_score = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomato_meter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores"
  )
```
